# Brand Voice Governance

`brand-voice-governance` · v1.0.1 · Execute · Content & Copy
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/brand-voice-governance/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Does this content follow our brand's own written voice rules, and which blocks must be revised before it ships?

**Inputs:** The content to check, and the brand's voice rules — either the brand-context brief or an explicit avoid-list, prefer-list, and reading-grade ceiling

**Output:** A block-by-block conformance report — pass/revise per block, every banned term and hedge quoted with its location, a conformance score, and an audit trail that traces each flag to its source

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill brand-voice-governance`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/brand-voice-governance/resources/voice-check.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/brand-voice-governance/resources/voice-check.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It applies literal, whole-word matching and a reading-grade rule to the text you paste. It misses paraphrases of banned words and cannot judge tone or how readers react.
- Without a brand avoid-list it falls back to AAJ house defaults. A pass on defaults is not a pass on your brand; check which ruleset the run used.
- Conformance is not quality. Copy can pass every rule and still be unclear or make unproven claims; run the aaj-copywriting scorer as well.
- The grade-10 ceiling is AAJ's working default, not a published standard. Set it from your brief, or dense technical copy will be flagged.

**Review before acting:** The brand or content lead confirms the parsed avoid-list and grade ceiling are the brand's real rules, and an editor reads flagship pages for tone, since the check only catches mechanical violations.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/brand-voice-governance](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/brand-voice-governance)
